    HOW TO PLAY

    Run the line long. Run it through the veins.

    A spark of drawn power runs from the focus stone to the beacon, touching each numbered anchor stone in turn. Current takes the path of least resistance, so it follows the easiest ground. Press Release to watch it run.

    You are the surveyor. Tap a tile to chalk a ward there: the current will not cross it, so the line bends around. Each ward costs 1 chalk. Tap it again to rub it out and get the chalk back.

    Iron seams run through the rock and the current cannot cross them either. Cutting one costs more chalk, shown on the survey chip, and leaves rubble behind. Tap the rubble to re-lay the seam and get the chalk back.

    Charged ground is thick with raw power. Every stretch the spark crosses there counts for far more. You bank charge for the distance it runs and the ground it runs through, so wind the line through the veins.

    The spark slips diagonally between wards that only touch at a corner, so join them edge to edge. You can never close the circuit off: a move that cuts off the beacon flashes red and is undone.

    Hit Submit to post your charge. Everyone in the world surveys the same daily ground, so bring friends.
